request: Inspect only existence (not values) of Astera v8 preconfigured OpenAI-compatible base URL, bearer, model, timeout and network mode; no model requests, credential transfer, modifications, or DebugAI interference.

bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
body=AI_CORE_SECOND_CONSUMER_ASTERA_PREFLIGHT
for n in astera-v8 astera-v8-evaluator astera-v8-evidence-search; do
 mode=$(docker inspect -f '{{.HostConfig.NetworkMode}}' "$n")
 fields=$(docker exec "$n" node -e 'for(const k of ["OPENAI_COMPAT_BASE_URL","OPENAI_COMPAT_API_KEY","OPENAI_COMPAT_MODEL","LLM_CHAIN","ASTERA_LLM_TIMEOUT_MS"])console.log(k+"="+(process.env[k]?"SET":"MISSING"))' | tr '\n' ',')
 body="$body $n NETWORK=$mode ENV=$fields"
done
gh api -X POST repos/seigo-gace/ai-core/issues/1/comments -f body="$body" --jq '.html_url' >/dev/null
printf 'ASTERA_ADAPTER_PREFLIGHT=POSTED\n'

chat_decision_checkpoint.source_evidence: Issue1 #6224120752 established real astera-v8, -evaluator, -evidence-search app containers have existing OpenAI compatible adapter; read only credential presence and network mode to avoid unapproved sharing. No source change.
